title: Capability Invocation ABI v1
description: The frozen semantic contract between a planning/reasoning runtime and the Crabedence execution kernel. Normative prose: docs/spec/capability-invocation-abi.md. The structural rules (R1-R9: valid UTF-8, exactly one JSON value, root is an object, no duplicate keys, nesting depth <= 64, known fields only, no explicit null for a known field, declared types) are enforced by internal/execution/invocation_abi.go, nemo/contracts/invocation-abi.ts, and runtimes/nemo-relay/bridges/nemo-crabedence/src/abi.rs. All three are bound to this file by tests; a field added here and not there (or the reverse) fails CI. There is deliberately no abi_version field: the semantic contract is enforced by the capability registry, not a version tag on the wire, and an unknown field is refused rather than ignored.

capability.description: Registered capability identifier. The registry resolves everything else about it.

arguments.description: Arguments for the capability, validated server-side against the registered argument schema under the exact-number JSON Schema model. Omit rather than send null.

authority.description: Identity and authorization material. Required at admission: an invocation whose capability pins an authority policy needs a resolvable authority_ref.

principal.description: Requesting principal. A claim unless the deployment enables peer authentication (CRABEDENCE_PEER_PRINCIPALS), which maps the Unix peer UID and replaces the claim before admission.

authority_ref.description: Opaque bearer reference to authority material. Treat as a credential: never log it. The ABI does not prescribe the mechanism (grant today; capability token, workload identity, or signed assertion later).

grant_id.description: Deprecated alias for authority_ref, accepted for backward compatibility and mapped to authority_ref when that field is absent.

authority_generation.description: Server-assigned binding of the exact immutable authority material. Accepted from the caller and overwritten by the server from the resolved grant; a caller can neither forge nor omit it.

authority_digest.description: Server-assigned digest of the resolved grant. Accepted from the caller and overwritten by the server.

execution_class.description: Advisory caller assertion only. The registry's pinned class is authoritative; a mismatch is denied rather than honored.

idempotency_key.description: Required for MUTATION and CRITICAL capabilities. Durable idempotency is the kernel's, not the planner's.

deadline.description: RFC3339 timestamp. The request is denied after this time.

mediation.description: Caller-declared middleware provenance — evidence, never a policy input. Present when middleware (including trusted native plugins) mediated the invocation. Its middleware, plugin, activation-config, original-argument, and release identities are bound into the request digest and persisted on the durable record; it cannot select route, provider, assurance, or authority. Raw activation configuration is never sent.

middleware_set_digest.description: Canonical digest naming the exact middleware set that mediated this invocation — activated plugin identities, registration descriptors, activation configuration, and host identity.

original_args_digest.description: Canonical digest of the caller's arguments before middleware ran, so a mediated request records both what was asked and what was dispatched.

release_root_digest.description: Component-manifest digest of the qualified distribution the composing runtime shipped in, when it runs inside one.

plugin_manifest_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the activated plugin manifest, when a plugin mediated the invocation.

plugin_library_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact activated plugin library bytes.

activation_config_sha256.description: Canonical SHA-256 of the activated component configuration; raw configuration is omitted because it may contain credentials.

session.description: Runtime-attestation binding — evidence the server verifies, never a grant. id is the session the attest_challenge/attest handshake issued; proof is the runtime's Ed25519 signature over the pipe-joined request binding (crabedence-session-proof-v1|session_id|capability|idempotency_key|principal|authority_ref|deadline|sha256(arguments)|sha256(mediation)), proving possession of the attested key for THIS request. When the deployment requires attestation an invocation without a verified session is denied.

id.description: Attested session identifier issued by the challenge/attest handshake.

proof.description: Base64 Ed25519 signature over the request binding, produced by the runtime key the session attested.
